result.summary: The image shows a wide, unmarked residential street with narrow sidewalks directly adjacent to the curb. There is a lack of pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, traffic calming, or buffers between the walkway and moving vehicles.

hazards.name: Wide unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable lane positioning.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a degraded sidewalk adjacent to a derelict, multi-story building with boarded-up windows and visible structural decay. There is a lack of pedestrian-scale lighting, greenery, or traffic calming measures, creating a desolate and potentially hazardous walking space.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk is cracked, uneven, and contains debris, posing a significant trip hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground walkway along the building frontage

hazards.name: Structural Hazards from Building
hazards.description: Broken windows and exposed, unfinished building materials suggest potential for falling debris onto the walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Upper floors of the adjacent building

hazards.name: Lack of Lighting
hazards.description: No street lights are visible, which would significantly reduce safety and visibility for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk surface to remove trip hazards and ensure ADA compliance.

interventions.title: Building Remediation
interventions.description: Secure or repair the adjacent derelict building to prevent falling debris and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety for pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures. The roadway is wide and lacks lane markings, which may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential context.

hazards.name: Wide unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable driver behavior.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: Visible cracking and patches in the roadway and sidewalk edges present minor trip hazards.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at intersections or mid-block to provide safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Lane markings and narrowing
interventions.description: Paint lane lines to define the travel way and use markings to visually narrow the road, encouraging slower speeds.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a narrow, poorly maintained sidewalk adjacent to a blank industrial frontage. A utility pole significantly obstructs the walkway, forcing pedestrians toward the curb edge in a space lacking any safety buffers or street trees.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A large wooden utility pole is situated in the middle of the narrow sidewalk, significantly reducing the effective walking width.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The concrete walkway is cracked, uneven, and shows signs of significant wear, creating potential trip hazards.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width to meet ADA standards and resurface the concrete to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Utility Undergrounding or Relocation
interventions.description: Move the utility pole out of the pedestrian clear zone to provide an unobstructed path for all users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Install street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and the roadway while improving the visual environment.
